results.caption:
📍 Metro View Restaurant – Opp. Sharaf DG Metro Station

🥑 Deal: Avocado Juice + Fries

💰 Original Price:—
🎉 Offer Price: AED 10
💸 You Save: AED 0

⭐ My Rating: 0/10

📝 Review:
This one was honestly a complete disappointment. We went to Metro View specifically to try their AED 10 Avocado Juice + Fries deal, but when we reached the restaurant, the staff told us they weren't aware of the offer or the Dubai Food Festival / Summer Surprises campaign.

And that's where the problem is. Having an offer advertised but not being able to serve it is disappointing but the outlet not even knowing about the offer makes the entire trip feel like a waste of time.

They do have several other affordable items, including Pav Bhaji for AED 5, Shawarma for AED 10 and Falafel for AED 3. I've tried their falafel before and actually enjoyed it. Unfortunately, many of the items we wanted to try were sold out when we visited.

💭 Value Verdict:
No offer = no savings.😐
I can't really rate the food deal because we couldn't try it in the first place. If an offer is being promoted, the outlet should be aware of it and be able to honour it. For this experience, it's a 0/10 from me.

Have you actually managed to get this deal at Metro View? Let me know! 👇
